ingredients.name: Snake gourd (pathola)
ingredients.notes: 1 medium snake gourd; scrape off the white outer layer, halve, scoop out the spongy seeded core, then slice into thin half-moons

ingredients.name: Red chilli powder
ingredients.notes: optional, for a slightly spicier version; this curry is traditionally very mild

ingredients.name: Maldive fish flakes
ingredients.notes: optional, for umami depth; omit for vegan

steps.instruction: Wash the snake gourd and scrape off the white, snowy outer layer with a knife to expose the green skin beneath. Split it lengthwise and scrape out the spongy, seeded core with a spoon.
Slice the cleaned snake gourd into thin half-moon slices. Rinse briefly and drain.

Place the sliced snake gourd, onion, garlic, green chillies, curry leaves, pandan leaf, fenugreek (if using), turmeric, chilli powder (if using), Maldive fish (if using), and salt into a saucepan. Mix everything together gently.
Add the water and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cover and cook for about 6-8 minutes, until the snake gourd is just tender but not falling apart.
Pour in the thick coconut milk. Stir gently and simmer uncovered for a further 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent the coconut milk from curdling. Avoid letting it boil vigorously.
Remove from heat and stir in the lime juice. Taste and adjust salt. Serve warm with rice or pol roti.

notes: Pathola maluwa is also called 'pathola kiri hodi' (snake gourd white curry) due to its pale, creamy colour and very mild spicing -- it is considered an everyday, gentle dish suitable even for children or anyone avoiding heavy spice. Snake gourd is closely related to loofah/calabash in taste and texture once cooked. Some cooks remove the inner spongy core and seeds before cooking (as in this recipe), while others leave it in for a softer, more textured curry; both are valid household preferences. Maldive fish flakes are optional, but many cooks consider them important for rounding out the dish's otherwise very mild flavour -- omit for a fully vegan version.
